description: Commit-before-entropy spot assignment for live card breaks, giveaways, raffles, or any contest where spots must be assigned to participants fairly. Submits {spots[], participants[], label?} to POST /v1/break on x402.fairseal.io (commitment immediately, then polls until the VDF epoch resolves, ~7-15s) and returns the full verifiable receipt with rule_hash, entropy, derivation string, assignment table, and offline verification steps. Receipts are cross-verifiable with the break.html web tool. Requires FAIRSEAL_ANCHOR_API_KEY or x402 $0.02 USDC payment.

participants.description: Participants to assign (must not exceed spots count; 1..500 unique strings)

spots.description: Ordered list of spots/items to fill (1..500 unique strings, max 100 chars each)

name: fairseal_break_assign
title: Verifiable spot assignment (FairBreak)
